issues.title: Ingest Greene County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $24,825,752 across 37 funds. The largest: Law Enforcement Fund ($9,356,955), County General Fund ($6,962,826), County Road Fund ($3,908,650). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
